tables.explanation: Execution stage: The repository contains plausible simple-concatenation baseline artifacts, but the exact Table 1 pipeline is only partially represented. The closest MNIST-only baseline is architecture-consistent with the paper but uses only two claim types and reaches about 71.8% rather than 85.1%; the broader cross-dataset baseline uses a different setup (five claim types, separate per-dataset training, text fine-tuning). Because no exact claim-matching implementation/artifact was found, the mismatch is not strong enough for a fabrication verdict, but the claim is not verified either.
tables.evidence: Reused saved execution artifacts instead of retraining: `logs/0-run/experiment_results/experiment_23b7cc9670dc469d91f273d62ad1176e_proc_1502176/experiment_data.npy` stores MNIST validation accuracies `0.7183333333333334`, `0.6983333333333334`, and `0.71` for 10/20/30 epochs (best observed `0.7183333333333334`), while `logs/0-run/experiment_results/experiment_787c7a47f00e4c4cba895078ef763dff_proc_1514333/experiment_data.npy` stores MNIST/fashion_mnist/SVHN best validation accuracies `0.7604166666666666`, `0.7708333333333334`, and `0.6916666666666667`.
